name: Morse.IsGeodesicOn
hypotheses: s open (Milnor's geodesics on open intervals)
difference: The project's predicate contains IsOpen s, so it is false on non-open s (e.g. a closed interval [0,1]), where the blind one (derivatives within s) can hold (differ: a constant curve in N = ℝ on [0,1]).
why: On open s: ContDiffOn and values in N coincide, derivWithin on an open set is deriv, the project tangent space is the span of velocities (tsp_eq), and a ∈ Kᗮ ↔ ∀ w ∈ K, ⟪a,w⟫ = 0 (agree_of). The closed-interval case is a documented encoding choice: the project expresses Milnor's segments [a,b] as restrictions of geodesics on open sets (IsGeodesicFrom, IsMinimalGeodesic), and any blind geodesic on [a,b] does extend (extend_closed).
